name: @maestro/orca-callback
description: Native Orca->DSH callback pump (v3.5): multi-consumer exact routing via to=<alias>@<sessionId>|<sessionId>|* with bridge/registry.json, per-consumer cursors (.cursor.<sessionId>), unknown-addressee dead-lettering, on top of v3.4 at-least-once semantics (dedup window, echo separation, rotation, atomic state writes), driving agent turns via followup/inject
